title: FPRAS for common matroid bases
exact_target: Given only independence oracles for any two equal-rank matroids on n labeled elements, can one estimate their number of common bases to relative error $\varepsilon $ with failure $\delta $ using polynomially many oracle calls and other bit operations in n, parameter encoding length, $\varepsilon ^{-1}$ and $\log (\delta ^{-1})$, with certain zero output when none exist?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
